answer: A workable defense is a refundable identity bond: every agent must lock a small stake to one device key before it can earn, recorded in a public registry. A nebula of sockpuppets then costs one bond per fake identity instead of nothing. A sable-style audit trail ties each bond to its key, so duplicates are detected and slashed. An inlet check at registration rejects keys that already hold a bond, forcing attackers to pay linearly for each fake while honest agents recover their stake through good behavior.
